categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhou International Group Holdings Limited operates primarily as a vertically integrated apparel manufacturer specializing in the manufacture and sale of knitwear products. Its product categories include sportswear, casual wear, lingerie wear, and other knitwear. The company serves internationally renowned brands and focuses on fabric and garment production.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group employs vertically integrated manufacturing processes with fabric and garment production bases in China, Cambodia, and Vietnam. It emphasizes intelligent manufacturing, automation, digitalization, and AI-driven manufacturing solutions to enhance production efficiency and product quality. The company also focuses on sustainable production methods, including green textiles and circular economy models.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves internationally renowned brand customers primarily in the sportswear, casual wear, and lingerie segments. Its key markets include Europe, Japan, the United States, China domestic market, and other Asia-Pacific countries. Major customers include several large clients each accounting for over 10% of revenue, reflecting strong relationships with global apparel brands.
categories.geographic_coverage: Shenzhou International operates production facilities in Mainland China, Vietnam, and Cambodia, with sales distributed across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas. Major revenue markets include Mainland China, the European Union, Japan, the United States, and other international regions such as Canada, South Korea, and the Philippines.
categories.supply_chain_position: The Group operates as an integrated midstream and downstream player in the apparel supply chain, covering fabric production, garment manufacturing, and direct sales to brand customers. It controls significant upstream fabric production capacity and downstream garment manufacturing, enabling vertical integration and supply chain synergy.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding overseas production capacity, enhancing vertical integration, and investing in R&D for new fabrics and advanced materials. The Group focuses on intelligent manufacturing, automation, digital transformation, sustainability, and green production to improve efficiency and product differentiation. It also emphasizes supply chain transparency, eco-friendly materials, and carbon neutrality initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through the sale of knitwear products to brand customers on a point-in-time basis upon delivery. Revenue is derived from manufacturing and selling sportswear, casual wear, lingerie, and other knitwear products, with payment terms generally ranging from 30 to 180 days after delivery.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, Shenzhou International is positioned as a leading vertically integrated apparel manufacturer with a strong global footprint and partnerships with internationally renowned brands. It competes by leveraging scale, vertical integration, advanced manufacturing technologies, and sustainability initiatives to maintain competitiveness amid rising labor costs and complex trade environments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The Group is a large-scale apparel manufacturer with over 102,000 employees and annual production capacity of 250,000 metric tons of fabric and 550 million garments. In 2024, it achieved record revenue of approximately RMB28.7 billion, a 14.8% increase year-on-year, and net profit attributable to owners of RMB6.24 billion, up 36.9%. The company has demonstrated steady growth and improved profitability despite challenging global economic conditions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shenzhou International emphasizes high-quality, differentiated, and functional apparel products tailored to evolving consumer preferences. Its value proposition includes rapid response capabilities, comprehensive services, supply chain agility, and sustainability leadership. The Group differentiates itself through vertical integration, advanced manufacturing technologies, eco-friendly production, and strong customer collaboration to create value for brand customers.
